assets.name: warden
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art character animation sprite atlas for Overload dark fantasy top-down RPG. A Manyborn WARDEN: full armored wandering knight, dark blue-steel plate with precise pale-metal edge highlights, long weathered teal cloak, brass trims, fully closed crested helmet with tiny luminous aqua slit, sword in right hand and kite shield in left. Strong sophisticated silhouette, detailed handcrafted pixel-art clusters. Make a PERFECT REGULAR 8-column by 8-row sprite sheet, square image 1024x1024, every cell exactly128x128 pixels. Each cell is a complete full-body sprite rendered on a conceptual 64x64 canvas then upscaled exactly 2x nearest-neighbor, no smoothing. IDENTICAL size and foot baseline in every cell: feet at cell center x64 y112; max body height80px, generous transparent gutter for sword, no cell overlap, no shadows/background/grids/labels/text. EIGHT facings, each COLUMN always one fixed facing: column0 east(right),1 southeast,2 south(toward camera),3 southwest,4 west(left),5 northwest,6 north(back),7 northeast. ROWS animate the SAME knight: row0 idle poised; row1 walk left foot forward, row2 walk passing left, row3 walk right foot forward, row4 walk passing right; row5 strong attack windup with sword drawn back and shield braced; row6 committed sword swing following through, no drawn swoosh; row7 recoiling from hit, cloak flaring. Every facing shows corresponding weapon silhouette. Slight forward oblique view, NOT isometric. Real transparent alpha background. Exact regular grid is critical for automatic sprite slicing. Original character. No smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no painterly, no blur.
